role_reported_en: Former President of the Republic (removed by the Senate on 6 Nov 2026)
role_reported_es: expresidente de la República (destituido por el Senado el 6/11/2026)
next_hearing: 2026-11-27 09:30: swearing-in of the expert for extraction of data from three phones (not a hearing on the merits)
defence_statement_en: Declares himself innocent; abstained from testifying on 7 Nov. Lawyer Ricardo Preda: Peña held no direct shares in the bank, only a stake in Ueno Holding sold by buyout (dated variously April 2025 or late 2024/early 2025) and audited by the Comptroller; the president does not tell agencies where to deposit; no act or file signed by Peña favouring the bank is identified; expects dismissal. No lawyer's response to the 13 Nov criminal-association charge was found.
defence_statement_es: Se declara inocente; se abstuvo de declarar el 7/11. El abogado Ricardo Preda: Peña no tenía acciones directas del banco sino una participación en Ueno Holding vendida mediante rescate (fechada en abril de 2025 o fines de 2024/inicios de 2025) y auditada por la Contraloría; el presidente no indica a los entes dónde depositar; no se identifica acto ni expediente firmado por Peña a favor del banco; espera el sobreseimiento. No se halló respuesta de sus abogados a la imputación por asociación criminal del 13/11.
place_reported: Regimiento Escolta Presidencial; traslado a Viñas Cué ordenado el 16/11/2026

prov.note: Related case (Causa 92/2026 per ABC 6 and 16 Nov). Held at Regimiento Escolta Presidencial, then moved to Viñas Cué military prison by order of 16 Nov. Presumption of innocence applies.
